summary: Independent fixed runtime passes, but source review fails C2: trusted session-link preflight and mutation can select different browser sources after an expired cookie-session lookup. Deterministic enrichment conflicts may therefore be discovered after identity writes. Root acceptance is held; this is not transactional-race speculation.

criteria.evidence: Inspected the strict profile discriminator and actual streamed JSON byte bound, typed fields/meanings, key and persisted UTF-8 limits, canonical original-time replacement/stale/replay/conflict and empty watermark rules. Both hosts compute subject batches before persistence; profile-only imports retain behavioral vectors/visit metadata, all-replay returns without writes, and validated DO outcomes preserve original indexes. Only applied behavioral rows call noteHistory. Fixed runtime verifies schema/bounds, replacements/replay, mixed counts and synthetic pure/mixed storage failures with retained persisted state and DO mirrors/owner/alarms. Existing behavioral/CSV paths and 52 legacy cases remain intact.

Blocking finding W14.05-R1 at src/identity/link.ts:119-130 versus :194-199: when a trusted caller supplies a valid-format cookieSessionId whose session is absent, exact(visitorId, cookieSessionId) returns null and preflight merges no source. After store.link at :158, linkOnSessionHost falls back to the browser's user pointer and can select a real enriched browser, then absorbIntoShopper rejects its equal-time conflicting snapshot or combined overflow. Thus a deterministic new partial identity link remains, contrary to the preflight contract. The public signed route supplies ownedSource and is not affected by this specific path. Independently inspected other C2 work: three enriched live/alarm contexts discard old stage-pinning membership; read helpers freshly tick/qualify current local/reflex/allowed ODP plus imported membership without writes/raw-value decision projection; co-located state survives reconstruction; typed pure/mixed imports preserve only existing exact audience authority and publish mirrors after storage commit. Fixed two-host/two-tenant read/live/restarted-alarm, signed merge/conflict/overflow/repoint, consent and erasure cases pass, but do not exercise the stale-cookie fallback defect.

Procedural/scope evidence only, not acceptance despite C2 failure. Read all nine forward deltas and relevant current source; independently verified every forward/reverse patch in memory against retained baseline/current bytes, including the newly absent baseline file. All 50 frozen artifact pins match before and after runtime; 36 protected pins unchanged; task contract and artifact digests recompute exactly. Three grouped SDK additions, unchanged legacy identity/direct fixtures and named W37.04 preserved. The exact independent compound ran once and passed 52 plus 4 selected cases, with 38 SDK cases intentionally unselected. Reused inspected final worker compiler 11450/499c27 and lint 48719/6c4f02, both exit0/drained; normalized warning multiset is 123 to 122, no additions (existing isShopperId import now used). Scoped whitespace 3f6f9e exit0 and literal new-file bd5b21 exit1/no diagnostics are accurately distinguished. W05.09 prior-artifact qualification and explicit residuals retained.

findings.scenario: Session host; trusted linkVisitor input has cookieSessionId naming a missing/expired session, user:<visitor> names that browser's actual enriched session, and the destination has incompatible enrichment. Preflight sees null, store.link writes identity state, then mutation falls back to the enriched browser and throws on merge.
findings.required_change: Align preflight with the actual own-browser fallback selection, or refuse that unresolved trusted source before store.link. Preserve public signed ownership and already/forward/repoint behavior; do not claim cross-store atomicity.
findings.runtime_reproduction: Not added or run by reviewer; fixed existing compound passes and does not cover this input. Lead confirmed same-contract blocker and requested focused rework.
